description: The same lump sum in an ISA and in a taxable general investment account over some years: the tax the GIA pays on dividends and gains, and the ISA's advantage. Use for 'is it worth using my ISA for this'.

amount.description: Lump sum invested today, in pounds.

dividendYieldPct.description: Of which paid as dividends. Defaults to 2.

growthRatePct.description: Total return a year. Defaults to 7.

taxBand.description: Income tax band. Defaults to basic.

name: calculate_isa_vs_gia
title: ISA vs general investment account
